issue_context.title: Can we improve the error message of incorrect dict syntax?
issue_context.body:
This is currently documented as a YAML parser issue:
```sql
tidb> CREATE PLACEMENT policy p4 LEADER_CONSTRAINTS="[+region=us-east-1]" FOLLOWER_CONSTRAINTS="{+region=us-east-2:2}" FOLLOWERS=2;
..
ERROR 1105 (HY000): label constraints in map syntax have invalid replicas: count of labels '+region=us-east-2:2' should be positive, but got 0: invalid FollowerConstraints

```

It needs to be specified instead as:
```sql
tidb> CREATE PLACEMENT policy p4 LEADER_CONSTRAINTS="[+region=us-east-1]" FOLLOWER_CONSTRAINTS="{+region=us-east-2: 2}" FOLLOWERS=2;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.10 sec)
```

I think this is going to be a common issue. If we can't fix it, can we improve the error message?

review_comments: I think it is better to do `return rules, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrInvalidConstraintsMapcnt, err)`, or even just `return rules, fmt.Errorf("%w:  wrong separator ...", ErrInvalidConstraintsMapcnt)`. We don't need to add a new error for every kind. And `errors.Is` should work for primitive error, I don't think `switch err` is needed.
ErrInvalidConstraintsMapcnt is too wordy for users to provide solutions. So "wrong separator ..." is better.
